description: Equivalent arrow spellings retain different Ty IDs; intersect operand order chooses different equivalent survivor; semantic denotation mixed with callable metadata. Red overloaded int->int + atom->int vs (int|atom)->int must share semantic identity, meet commutative in ID; preserve distinct callable provenance/brands where meaningful. Coordinate arrow-conjunction agent; no O(store size) equivalence scan or equality-only shim. One fresh agent, one commit onto PR215.
title: Make type identity independent of equivalent construction and metadata
